name: FormVis
title: layered image compositing with local AI on your own machine
summary: FormVis is a layered image editor with selection, painting and retouching tools, 27 blend modes, adjustment layers, layer styles, PSD files, local generation and an MCP server with 134 tools.
lede: FormVis is a layered image editor: stack photos and paintings as layers, group them in folders, mask and clip them, blend them, select, paint and export. It saves its own .fvd projects, opens layered PSD and PSB files, and runs in a browser or as a desktop app for macOS, Linux and Windows. Selection, background removal, fill and upscaling run on local models.
runs_on: macOS, Linux and Windows, in a browser or as a Tauri 2 desktop app
checks: Composites layers with pass-through folders, 27 blend modes, raster and folder masks, clipping chains and fill layers.
Edits with selection, painting and retouching tools, adjustment layers, filters, Smart Objects and layer styles.
Selects, removes backgrounds and fills with local models: SAM 2.1, U2-Net, LaMa and Real-ESRGAN, with models fetched on first use and pinned to checksums.
Opens and saves .psd and .psb with layers, masks, clipping, blend modes and live adjustment layers.

facts.dd: .fvd with a thumbnail inside; also opens .fmv and .formvis from earlier releases and NodeMode canvasor projects
Vanilla TypeScript 7 and Vite 8, Python and FastAPI, and Tauri 2
755 commands in one catalogue, shared by the menus, palette, MCP tools and ./formvis cli

chapters.title: A layered document model
chapters.text: Flat bottom-to-top layers with pass-through folders, 27 blend modes, raster and folder masks, clipping chains, fill layers and value-snapshot history of 100 steps.

chapters.title: Selection, fill and generation without a cloud
chapters.text: Object Selection runs SAM 2.1 on ONNX Runtime, background removal uses U2-Net or GrabCut, and Selection-Aware Fill, Generative Fill and Expand work with LaMa on any computer. Krea 2 Turbo and FLUX.2 klein 4B generate images on this computer with no key (Apple silicon; Krea 2 also on an NVIDIA GPU).

chapters.title: Edit by asking
chapters.text: The MCP server gives Claude Code, Codex and Cursor 134 tools for files, layers, text, selections, filters and the command catalogue, with approvals and an activity feed. Window > Terminal and Window > Claude Code put a shell and Claude Code in the window.

features.title: Layered document model
features.text: Layers, folders, masks and fill layers.
bullets: 27 blend modes in the standard order
Raster masks, folder masks and clipping chains
Fill layers: Solid Color, Gradient and Pattern
History of 100 steps and 256 MB

features.title: Selection, paint and type tools
features.text: Selection, painting, retouching and transform tools.
bullets: Marquee, Lasso, Object Selection, Quick Selection and Magic Wand
Brush, Pencil, Eraser, Mixer Brush and the retouching brushes
Spot Healing, Healing Brush, Patch and Clone Stamp
Pen paths that become selections or shape layers

features.title: Adjustments and filters
features.text: Adjustments as editable adjustment layers above your pixels.
bullets: Levels, Curves, Hue/Saturation, Vibrance, Color Balance, Selective Color
Color Lookup with 3D LUT .cube files
Gradient Map, HDR Toning, Shadows/Highlights and Develop

features.title: Layer styles and Smart Objects
features.text: Non-destructive effects that save in the project.
bullets: Drop Shadow, Glows, Stroke, Satin, Bevel and Emboss, and overlays
Smart Objects keep original pixels with editable filters
Edit Contents opens the original as its own document

features.title: Type and brushes
features.text: Editable text layers and a full brush engine.
bullets: Warp Text's fifteen styles and type along a pen path
Brush Settings: tip shape, dynamics, scattering, dual brush, wet edges
Sampled tips and presets from .abr files

features.title: Files and colour
features.text: Many formats in and out, with real colour management.
bullets: PSD and PSB with layers, masks and live adjustments
Camera RAW import for DNG, CR2, CR3, NEF, ARW and more through LibRaw
HEIC, TIFF, QOI, Netpbm, TGA and ICO
8, 16 and 32 bits a channel with OpenEXR, Radiance HDR and DPX
Profile assignment and conversion for RGB, CMYK, Gray and Lab

features.title: Local generation and selection
bullets: Object Selection with SAM 2.1
Remove Background with U2-Net or OpenCV GrabCut
Selection-Aware Fill, Generative Fill and Expand with LaMa
Image > Upscale with Real-ESRGAN

features.title: Graphics processor
features.text: The canvas draws through WebGPU or WebGL2.
bullets: Metal on macOS, Vulkan on Linux and Direct3D 12 on Windows in the native wgpu renderer
Falls back to the CPU per document, with the reason in the status bar
A native Rust renderer, formvis-render, over wgpu

features.title: Actions, plugins and scripts
bullets: Record Actions and Batch a set of images into one zip
Sandboxed JavaScript plugins and a Script Console
Timeline of frames exported as an animated GIF

features.title: Agents and the assistant
features.text: MCP tools and an in-app chat.
bullets: 134 MCP tools and the formvis-driving skill
Window > Agent Connect with per-agent policy, approvals and an activity feed
Window > Assistant edits the open document with Plan first and Undo This Turn
./formvis agents install sets up all three clients

features.title: Workspace
bullets: Window > Arrange: tile, 2-up to 6-up, Match Zoom and Location
Edit > Toolbar drags tools between groups
Home with Start, Recent, Projects and Outputs pages

features.title: Thirty languages
features.text: Chosen in Preferences, or from the system language at first start.
bullets: Switch in place
Arabic and Hindi are drafts for review
NodeMode tokens and theme profiles

parity.summary: The baseline is 53 rows, with three platform rows shown but not scored. FormVis was traced in its own code at 1.97.1 and no graded row moved: the four partial rows stay partial. Photon, GIMP, Krita and PhotoCraft are the other columns.

requirements: Rust stable and the Tauri 2 system packages for the desktop build
docs.install:
git clone https://github.com/nodemode-dev/formvis.git
cd formvis
./formvis install
Windows: formvis.bat install
docs.agents: An MCP server with 134 tools and the formvis-driving skill; ./formvis agents install sets up Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.

topics.title: Ports
topics.text: The frontend dev server runs at http://localhost:5190 and the engine at http://127.0.0.1:8190.

topics.title: Local models
topics.text: ./formvis install includes ONNX Runtime, so SAM 2.1, U2-Net, LaMa and Real-ESRGAN fetch their models on first use; docs/LOCAL.md lists what runs locally.

topics.title: Manual and help
topics.text: Help > FormVis Help (F1) opens docs/MANUAL.md with search, and Edit > Search (Ctrl+K) runs any command.

topics.title: Command line
topics.text: ./formvis cli list, describe and run reach the 755-command catalogue.

topics.title: Status
topics.text: The README lists what is not verified yet, including the desktop app and the graphics processor on real hardware.
